We have already done some Prototyping & validations, just need to settle on the error codes grouping based on feedback, this is going to help the community massively Hey <@827653956955406406> that was a nice PR for the docusaurus, but actually we don't recommend you use that plugin, but instead bump to the generator 2.x.x which should be able to be run locally or you can attempt to migrate the one from metamask, it's not in great shape, and we don't have access to update it to make into good shape. If you stay on the open-rpc/generator package we'll be able to maintain it and add updates especially since the mono repo overhaul we did and ecosystem update. <@403636673914863626> ^^^ <@403636673914863626> I wrote a quick issue about it here https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/660 sorry I missed the pr discussion on it earlier I'll take a look at it and see what it will take to switch again, since we just merged the docusaurus one 😕 Seems like it's pretty painless to update - https://github.com/acolytec3/execution-apis/pull/2 🤞 I tried to keep the execution-api's repo in mind when updating it(tested it a few months ago), looks like the minimal set of required changes to me thanks for tire kicking the changes for v2 generator 😄 Yeah, it builds and loads fine. will get some input from others whether it's okay as is or is they want some tweaks to how the layout looks

excerpts.author: smimz
excerpts.content: Thank you Zane, Would really appreciate some feedback from Clients on this. We have already done some Prototyping & validations, just need to settle on the error codes grouping based on feedback, this is going to help the community massively

excerpts.author: zcstarr
excerpts.content:
Hey <@827653956955406406> that was a nice PR for the docusaurus, but actually we don't recommend you use that plugin, but instead bump to the generator 2.x.x which should be able to be run locally or you can attempt to migrate the one from metamask, it's not in great shape, and we don't have access to update it to make into good shape. It was in better shape than the generator one , but is now behind the new 2.x.x version which is still gatsby but modern deps up and down. 

If you stay on the open-rpc/generator package we'll be able to maintain it and add updates especially since the mono repo overhaul we did and ecosystem update.
